content.text: nticonvulsants: mood stabilizers, BD mono, anxiety, acute depression BD, acute mani, antipsych
-    Note: valproic acid (Depakene) = same valproate family as divalproex (see Divalproex)
-    MOA: ↑GABA (⍉ GABA-transaminase -> ↑[GABA]) + block Na+/T-type Ca2+ channels -> ↓neuronal excitability
-    Clin Use: acute mania (bipolar)    -    sz    -    migraine ppx
-    Caution: ⍉ hepatic dz, POLG mitochondrial dx, urea cycle dx    -    preg — avoid unless others failed (effective contraception)
-    Monitoring: serum levels — mania 50-125 mcg/mL, epilepsy 50-100    -    LFTs prior + frequently (esp first 6 mo)    -    CBC/platelets (thrombocytopenia ↑ at ≥110 F / ≥135 M)
-    BBW: hepatotoxicity (usually first 6 mo; <2y highest risk)    -    pancreatitis    -    fetal risk (NTD, ↓IQ, neurodevelopmental dx)
